blocks.text: This chapter introduced algorithms and problem-solving: defining and classifying computational problems as solvable or unsolvable and tractable or intractable; the generate and test method; problem types such as search, sorting, optimization and decision; design techniques including greedy algorithms, divide and conquer, dynamic programming and backtracking; commonly used algorithms; and efficiency and complexity analysis with Big O notation. Algorithmic thinking means evaluating and balancing trade-offs according to the needs of each problem.
